hooks.command: t="${CHECK_EVERY_TOOL_CALL:-}"; case "$t" in *://*) d="$HOME/.cache/check-every-tool-call/workshop"; [ -d "$d/.git" ] || git clone -q --depth 1 "$t" "$d" >/dev/null 2>&1; t="$d/tools/check-every-tool-call";; esac; if [ -z "$t" ]; then for c in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/../*; do if [ -f "$c/tools/check-every-tool-call/do-work/check_switches.py" ]; then t="$c/tools/check-every-tool-call"; break; fi; done; fi; if [ -f "$t/do-work/check_switches.py" ]; then exec python3 "$t/do-work/check_switches.py" run "${CHECK_LIST_SETTINGS:-$t/read-data/settings.json}"; fi; echo '{"systemMessage": "check list unreachable: no Workshop (CHECK_EVERY_TOOL_CALL names none and none is beside this repository)"}'
